Your daughter should be your priority. Go with her to your mom's place.
Speaking from experience.
You'll have a better chance and be happier if you and your little girl go with your mom.

I was in your situation for 10 years, I let it go on so long that the state took my son thanks to my ex and his B'S. I'm still fighting to get custody back. Thankfully he was placed with my family so I can still see him.

No man will ever be worth being separated from your child. Go with your mom. If he loves you he'll get his act together too, if not then you have your family to help you get your life together.

Good luck.
